title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 1: the vision by the river Chebar - four living creatures, wheels full of eyes and the likeness of a throne.

questions.text: Where was the speaker among the captives when the heavens were opened and he saw visions of God?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:1 says he was among the captives by the river Chebar when the heavens were opened and he saw visions of God.

answers.text: At the gate of the temple

questions.text: Whose son was Ezekiel the priest, to whom Yahweh's word came?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:3 says Yahweh's word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar.

questions.text: What came out of the north at the start of the vision?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:4 describes a stormy wind out of the north: a great cloud with flashing lightning and a brightness around it.

answers.text: A stormy wind with a great cloud and flashing lightning
A chariot drawn by horses of fire and a rider
A pillar of smoke rising from a burning city
A great swarm of locusts covering the sky

questions.text: How many faces and how many wings did each of the living creatures have?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:6 says everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

questions.text: The sole of their feet was like the sole of what?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:7 says their feet were straight, the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot, and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

questions.text: Which face did the four living creatures have on the right side?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:10 says the four of them had the face of a lion on the right side and the face of an ox on the left side.

questions.text: What was the appearance of the wheels like?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:16 says the appearance of the wheels was like a beryl, and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

answers.text: Like a beryl, a wheel within a wheel

questions.text: What were the rims of the wheels full of all around?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:18 says their rims were high and dreadful, and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

questions.text: What was the noise of their wings like when they went?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:24 says he heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army.

answers.text: Like the blast of a trumpet on the high mountains
Like the roaring of a lion among the mountains
Like the noise of great waters and the voice of the Almighty
Like the breaking of great trees in a storm

questions.text: What did he do when he saw the appearance of the likeness of Yahweh's glory?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:28 says that when he saw it he fell on his face, and he heard a voice of one that spoke.

answers.text: He covered his eyes with his robe and prayed
He fell on his face and heard a voice speaking
He stood up and began to sing a song of praise
He ran away from the river
